records.question: How many customers signed up before 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_signed_up FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date < '2024-01-01'

records.question: What is the most expensive product?
records.generated_sql: SELECT product_name, price AS most_expensive_price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many products belong to the Home & Kitchen category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Home & Kitchen'

records.question: How many orders are there in total?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

records.question: How many customers live in Bengaluru?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_in_bengaluru FROM customers c WHERE c.city = 'Bengaluru'

records.question: What is the lowest stock quantity among all products?
records.generated_sql: SELECT MIN(stock_quantity) AS lowest_stock_quantity FROM products

records.question: How many orders were delivered in 2026?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01'

records.question: What is the average amount of paid card payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS average_card_payment FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_method = 'card'

records.question: How many customers from Gujarat have placed at least one order?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_from_gujarat FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.state = 'Gujarat'

records.question: What is the total amount of failed payments?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS failed_payments_amount FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'failed'

records.question: How many orders were placed in December 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_placed_in_december FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

records.question: How many products cost more than 2000?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p WHERE p.price > 2000

records.question: How many payments were made via cash on delivery?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cash_on_delivery_payments FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery'

records.question: What is the total revenue from paid card payments made in 2024?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS card_revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND p.payment_method = 'card' AND p.payment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND p.payment_date < '2025-01-01'

records.question: How many customers placed more than 10 orders?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 10) t

records.question: Which state has the highest revenue?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.state, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.state
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers have had both a cancelled order and a delivered order?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count 
FROM (SELECT o.customer_id 
      FROM orders o 
      WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled', 'delivered') 
      GROUP BY o.customer_id 
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.status) = 2) t

records.question: Which payment method has the highest total paid amount?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT p.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_paid
FROM payments p
WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.payment_method
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers have not placed any order in 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01')

records.question: What is the total revenue from Electronics products?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS electronics_revenue 
FROM order_items oi 
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id 
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id 
JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id 
WHERE cat.category_name = 'Electronics' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
